notes.title: v1.051 - Anti-Crash Hotfix
notes.content:
Dear Players,

It's time for a yet another community-inspired update! A few days ago, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/sreok]Sreok[/url] reported 2 issues with the Castle that should no longer be present in the game:

1) The gap you could fall through in the Castle is now filled with floor.
2) "Talking" to NPC_Demon should no longer crash the game.
___

3) On top of that, there was a specific bug that caused Grizzland to crash upon character's death on Level 5. It shouldn't happen anymore.

If you ever encounter a bug in Grizzland, please let me know about your experience in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/603110/discussions/0/1642041106351269915]this forum section![/url] :)

Yours forever,
Khud0

notes.title: v1.05 - Easy life and better performance!
notes.content:
Dear players,

During the last couple of weeks, I have been working on a "finalizing touch" for Grizzland. I added some features that were suggested or inspired by our wonderful community to make this grizzled world a cozy place to be.

[h1]Some "hidden" functions are now available in the game itself (previously you could only access them by tweaking the game files):[/h1]
- V-Sync and Text Speed were added to the game settings.
- You can now delete the save files and reset a speedrun from the "save file choosing screen" (inspired by question from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/AltariaDemon]Twix[/url]).
- The 2 hidden NPCs (you won't find them on the map) can now resurrect all the bosses and activate "invisible walls" mode. The latter will expire upon death.
- You no longer have to "stand on" the in-game Radio to listen to its music.
- Brightness was removed from settings (because it was dumb :D).
- Snow effect will last until player dies or enters the Castle.
- You can now change the localization files in Steam_Files_Folder > Grizzland and the results will be loaded into the game. However, I believe that the files will be replaced with each update, so please keep a copy of them somewhere if you decide to change something in them. :)

[h1]Miscellaneous:[/h1]
- Prices in the shop are now shown in coins, not hearts. (Reported by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/UunicoyY/]UNICOY[/url]);
- You should no longer be able to hold the Jump button to generate infinite amounts of particles and annoying jump sounds if you're standing right under the wall/slope;	
- The game's stability and performance should be much better now.
- Saving/Loading processes are now asynchronous and happen less often. 
- If you had previously unlocked an achievement in offline mode and still haven't got it on Steam, you might lose this progress.
- Gamepad tooltips were added in a couple of new places.
- You can now see visited secret rooms in "Journal" - "Notes".
- Secret Magnet will only "show" secrets you haven't found and secret rooms you haven't visited.
	
[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
- A rare issue which caused players to waste money in the shop without getting the item should no longer appear;
- Self-destructing while your arrow is on the screen should no longer crash the game. (Reported by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/UunicoyY/]UNICOY[/url]);

[h1]Speedrun Related:[/h1]
- Timer will now show "more accurate" time. It is now updating more often and the format has been changed to the proper "00:00" (instead of "00:0", for example).
- The special event/cutscene on level 5 should no longer be triggered in Speedrun mode. 

I hope that you will enjoy the update! :)

Yours forever,
Khud0

notes.title: v1.03 - Nerf
v1.02 - Polish Language, Map, Saves and more!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

As with update v1.01, this patch is only possible thanks to our precious community! :grizzland_heart:

[h1]What's New:[/h1]
1. A wonderful Polish streamer/youtuber, [url=youtube.com/kantallive]kantal[/url], has translated Grizzland into Polish!
2. Map is now available from the Journal! (Suggested by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198182794809]MrCrungle[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U_H7cpmi2hE]Wanderbot[/url] and many other YouTubers).
3. You can now see exactly when your checkpoint position changes. ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198182794809]MrCrungle[/url]) 
4. It is now possible to save on "dry" Trees.
5. Tutorial transition should be a bit more understandable. ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197988650549]Diving Naked Fat Man[/url])

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
1. First tree will no longer crash the game. ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/kyuusensei]Professor Q[/url])
2. You can now properly enlarge while being next to the Tree. ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198182794809]MrCrungle[/url])

In addition to everything above, there were a few minor bug fixes, tweaks and performance improvements.

I hope that you will find this update enjoyable! :)

Yours forever,
Khud0

notes.title: v1.01 - Gamepad Stick movement, currency in Journal
notes.content:
Dear Players,

I've watched all of the videos about Grizzland and visited a couple of Streams. This update is only possible thanks to [u]your[/u] feedback!

[h1]Change Log:[/h1]
1. Everyone who played Grizzland using a gamepad suggested adding [b]movement with the left stick.[/b] There you go, you can now move, shrink, enlarge and interact using it! (Text Skip is still on button up, though).
2. All the creators who completed the "bat quest" tried to look for the [b]reward in their Journal[/b]. It wasn't there before, but now it is, along with other currencies in the game.
3. As suggested by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/dollppin/]dollppin[/url], you can now see the main NPCs and Shops when you look at the Map.
4. I changed a few confusing places in the game.
5. Fixed a few minor bugs.

Videos and Streams I mentioned can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/603110/discussions/0/1642041886374397411/]here[/url].

I hope that you will enjoy the update! :grizzland_heart:

Yours forever,
Khud0
